What Our Guests Say
Kieran B.
4 Days in Paradise
A spectacular stay amongst the treetops with exceptional comfort. Our Jungle House is marvellously hidden away from the noisy part of town. All staff members were a delight, providing easy information and service throughout. We cannot recommend this stay enough!
Nathan A.
Beautiful stay in a Treehouse
One of the most beautiful and unique places we ve ever stayed. We stayed two nights at the Happy Nest, which sits along the Sok river. We were in awe of the beauty of the surroundings and the density of the jungle. If you are a lover of nature and rainforests, this is a must. We ll be back!
Charlotte K.
Authentic jungle experience
It was like a dream come true to fall asleep in a treehouse to the sounds of nature. So beautiful and calm with plenty of opportunities to go on excursions. The rafting was awesome and the river is nice for a refreshing swim. Particularly enjoyed the vibe in the bar for a quiet drink and some good music.
Venture Family
Friendly staff, lovely place
Sleeping in the jungle is exciting! The bungalows are comfy and clean. The food was delicious and they made all Thai dishes vegan at our request. The staff were very nice, and went out of their way to help us. Thank you, Khao Sok National Park was an experience that we will never forget!
Nir Y.
Among Monkeys & Nature
One day we found ourselves surrounded by playful monkeys outside our bungalow! It was magical to watch them swing through the branches, and even more exciting to capture a few photos from our balcony. Our room was comfortable and clean, blending perfectly with the jungle atmosphere.
Tejal P.
Absolutely amazing!!
The tree houses were a complete experience! Surrounded by the jungle and yet still cozy and welcoming. The staff were brilliant. Nothing was ever too much effort and they went out of their way to assist in whatever was needed. I cannot recommend it enough!!! Thank you so much.
Kristin A.
Naturally crafted
Stunning jungle treehouses. We had monkeys playing right outside our room and the river to swim in right behind us. Incredibly coloured birds flying around. The food and drinks were great, and the service was friendly. The tours were very organized with great guides and transportation.
Clara C.
Respect nature, expect the most!
Great experience in an amazing place ! We ve enjoyed staying in the middle of the jungle, The rooms are truly amazing! The hotel is made to make the experience unique while totally respecting the environment and nature: you adapt, not the other way around! Would love to go back.
Gabe S.
Nothing else like it
Unique and experienced This was one of the coolest and most unique stays I ve ever done. The fact that these folks have been doing this for 30 years really shows through. All of the staff were incredibly friendly and hospitable the whole time. The variety of activities were really nice. The Khao Sok Lake trip is a must-do.
Treehouses and Bungalows
Stay in the original Khao Sok treehouse resort, with unique jungle treehouses and bungalows set in the rainforest of Khao Sok National Park . See and hear the beat of the forest from your balcony - perfect for nature lovers.
You can choose your accommodation , join guided jungle activities , or book a complete Khao Sok tour package .
Book your room and organize your own personalized experience
View our rooms
What sets us apart?
Our Jungle House is more than a place to stay - it is a long-standing eco-project supporting converation and local communities.
With us, you re part of something bigger. Learn more about how your stay supports our conservation and community projects .
Here s how you make a difference
Your stay directly supports guide training, scholarships, and environmental education for thousands of children. Specifically, we direct 15% of profits to Jungle Life Camp, the Andaman Center, and vocational training.
Building a Brighter Future
For every night you spend with us, two local students are able to attend Jungle Life Camp - a nonprofit center teaching the next generation to take care of the environment.
Project Details
Nature education for 4,026 kids in 2024
Conservation of endangered lowland forest
Kayak and guide training for local teenagers
Learning Center for 200 at-risk youth

Khao Sok national park accommodation in unique treehouses
Hotel Accommodation - Our Rooms
Unique lodging, nestled into the jungle
From large family treehouses to intimate bungalows, our accommodation in Khao Sok National Park offers a unique way to experience the rainforest. Stay at the original treehouse resort in Khao Sok, where nature is all around you — with jungle views, river sounds, and wildlife just outside your door. Whether you’re traveling as a couple, a family, or simply looking to reconnect with nature, each stay is designed to immerse you in the environment while offering thoughtfully designed comfort, private en-suite facilities, and everything you need for a relaxed and memorable stay.
Disconnect to Reconnect
No WiFi or TV in the rooms — just you and the jungle. WiFi is available at restaurant.
Nature All Around
Wake up to monkeys in the trees and the sounds of the jungle — it s all around you.
Eco-friendly Comfort
Treehouses designed to stay fresh with air flow and shade — no A/C needed.
Prefer air-conditioned comfort while staying close to nature? Our sister property, Lost Horizon Resort , offers spacious air-conditioned villas in a peaceful rainforest setting.

Room Details
Enjoy a carefully balanced blend of comfort and nature in the heart of the jungle. Each room at Our Jungle House is thoughtfully designed to enhance your connection to the surrounding environment, while providing the essential comforts expected from a high-quality stay.
Natural airflow, elevated structures, and shaded design help keep rooms cool, while private en-suite bathrooms, comfortable beds, and well-planned spaces ensure a relaxing and enjoyable experience.
What s included in every room:
1
Comfortable beds with high-quality linens
2
Private balcony or terrace with jungle or river views
3
En-suite bathroom with hot water and eco-friendly amenities
4
Mosquito net for restful sleep
5
Ceiling or standing fan for natural cooling
6
Drinking water with refillable bottles available at the restaurant
Please note: Rooms are intentionally designed without air conditioning or in-room WiFi to support a more natural and environmentally conscious stay. WiFi is available in shared areas such as the reception and restaurant.

Who This Stay Is Perfect For
Our Jungle House offers a unique experience for different types of travelers visiting Khao Sok National Park:
Couples – Private, peaceful treehouses surrounded by jungle, ideal for a quiet and memorable escape.
Families – Spacious family treehouses and access to engaging nature-based activities.
Nature Lovers – An immersive rainforest setting with wildlife, river views, and eco-conscious design.
Treehouses vs bungalows
Choosing the right room depends on your travel style:
Treehouses:
Elevated jungle experience
Ideal for couples and families
Surrounded by forest canopy and wildlife
Bungalows:
Ground-level access
Easier accessibility
Close to gardens and pathways
Where to stay in Khao Sok?
A world-class location is what makes Our Jungle House one of the most unique places to stay in Khao Sok National Park . Unlike other resorts, our treehouses and bungalows are widely spaced across 12 acres of rainforest, offering privacy and a true connection to nature.
Situated on the banks of the Sok River, the rooms are set within lush jungle surroundings, with views ranging from forest and gardens to limestone cliffs and the river. Spacious decks, comfortable interiors, and well-designed bathrooms combine to create a stay that feels both immersive and relaxing.
We are perfectly positioned for exploring Cheow Lan Lake and the surrounding national park. If you’re planning your visit, our Cheow Lan Lake travel guide provides a detailed overview of what to expect.

How to get to Khao Sok - Detailed travel information
How to Get to Khao Sok
Detailed Travel Information
Situated between Thailand s east and west coasts, Khao Sok is easily accessible from tourist hotspots like Phuket, Krabi and Surat Thani via public and private transport. You have many choices when deciding how to get to Khao Sok. We have listed travel options below to help you plan a smooth journey. When it s time to leave you will probably start your journey from the Khao Sok van station. We ve got you covered.
For specific locations follow the Getting here links. See below for more travel information on Flights, Private Transfers, Self-drive, a full list of travel times and what to expect on arrival.

Private Transfers to Khao Sok
We can arrange private transportation, via a car or a van, from anywhere in Southern Thailand.
From the east: Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Koh Tao,
From the west: Khao Lak, Krabi, Phuket
From the islands: Koh Lanta, Koh Phi Phi, and the Similan Islands.
If you are coming directly from one of the islands, we can arrange a private pick-up from any pier. A car can usually fit two adults and luggages, or three adults with smaller amounts of luggage. We recommend a van for three or more people.

How to get to Khao Sok by car or motorbike
For guests who prefer a self-drive trip to Our Jungle House and Khao Sok National Park, the roads are well maintained and the directions are easy to follow. You can key in our GPS coordinates: GPS: 8.9105, 98.5310 (+8° 54 37.8″, +98° 31 51.6″)
Note: Please be aware that during the rainy season, the gravel road connecting Our Jungle House and Khao Sok Town can become very muddy in patches which makes it challenging for small-capacity motorcycles to travel on.
At OJH, we have a gravel and grass parking area, both uncovered, located beside the reception area.
Khao Sok Van Station
Many people will arrive or depart from the Khao Sok van station. It is located some 1.8 kms from the village on highway 401. We will arrange pick up and drop off for you. Just contact reception with your travel plans.

Reservations and Bookings
Can I book a room only?
Yes, we offer room-only bookings. You can book directly at our Room Booking page.
Do I need to book activities in advance, or can I book when I arrive?
Lake trips, elephant experiences, and jungle camping require booking in advance. For other activities, pre-booking is appreciated but not required.
Is breakfast included at Our Jungle House?
Package bookings include all meals. Room-only prices do not include breakfast. However, we have a full-service onsite restaurant open from 7:30am to 8:30pm every day.
Are there restrictions for small children?
Children 4 years and younger are not advised to join overnight lake trips. We do suggest the Full Day Lake Tour for families with younger children, however as these are joined trips, and families may feel rushed. Please contact us for details.
We are travelling to Khao Sok with small children, are we able to do the lake trip?
In general, yes, however joining a group tour means you must follow the pace of the group, and this can possibly feel too rushed for families with younger children. Please keep in mind that we always recommend Private Trips for families, especially with younger children. Please be advised to bring your own child’s life jacket or arm bands for your trip.
I am travelling to Khao Sok by myself, can I still join lake tours, hikes and other activities?
Yes, Our Jungle House offers most of its tours on a join-in/shared basis for solo travellers. Please let us know at your earliest convenience so that we can join you with one of our group tours. Both the Full Day and Overnight lake tours are suitable for solo travellers, but please note that a single surcharge applies to single-room arrangements.
Payment
How do I make a reservation?
After you select a room or package, we collect a deposit to confirm your reservation. Deposits can be paid via major credit cards and bank transfers. Learn more about our Payment and Cancellation Policies here
Is it possible to change the booking date?
We will try our best to accommodate date changes. Please read our Cancellation Policies .
Can I pay our remaining balance by credit card?
If needed, credit card payments are accepted with applicable surcharges. Payments made through our online payment gateway, Flywire, are subject to a 3% surcharge . Payments made by credit card machine at the resort are subject to a 4% surcharge to cover banking and processing fees. Guests with a Thai bank account can also make payments via mobile banking.
When do I pay for additional services?
Additional services, such as tours, transfers, or other fees, are to be processed and settled at reception upon check-out only. If asked by a supplier to pay directly, please inform the hotel team immediately.
How can we pay at Our Jungle House?
Please note that Khao Sok is a primarily cash-driven area, and we kindly ask for cash payments at the resort whenever possible. Due to our remote location, we rely on cash to pay our guides and local suppliers. For your convenience, there’s an ATM on our property. While we do accept Euros and US Dollars, please note that a commission is applied on top of the exchange rate to cover the cost of transportation to the nearest bank, which is located a considerable distance away.
If needed, credit card payments are accepted with a 3% surcharge. Guests with a Thai bank account can also make payments via mobile banking. All rooms are equipped with a safety deposit box for your peace of mind.
Fuel Surcharge
Why is there a fuel surcharge on lake tours?
Due to a significant increase in fuel prices in Thailand, influenced in part by global supply conditions and ongoing international developments, a temporary fuel surcharge has been introduced for our lake tour operations. This allows us to continue providing safe, reliable, and high-quality experiences without compromising our service standards.
Effective immediately, the following surcharge applies to individually booked Cheow Lan Lake tours and package arrangements:
THB 350 per person for overnight lake tours
THB 250 per person for lake day trips
Children (4–10 YOA) receive a 50% discount, while infants (0–3 YOA) are exempt from these charges.
We have made every effort to keep this adjustment minimal and truly appreciate your understanding as we adapt to rising operational costs.
Thank you for your continued support.
Transport and Getting Here
Can you arrange to pick me up?
Yes, we can arrange a pick-up from anywhere in Southern Thailand. You can find detailed travel instructions on our Getting to Khao Sok page.
Do you provide a baby seat or car seat for private transfers?
Yes, we can provide a baby seat or a child seat. Please let us know your requirements when you make your reservation.
What is the closest airport to Our Jungle House?
Surat Thani Airport is the closest to Khao Sok and Our Jungle House, about 1 hour 45 minutes (106 km) away. Krabi Airport, 155 km away, takes only about 30 minutes longer and offers more domestic and international flight options. Phuket Airport is 139 km or roughly 2.5 hours away, with convenient connections to a wide range of destinations.
Is it possible to arrange a late pick-up at 22:00 or later?
Private transfers can be arranged at any time to suit your travel plans.
I am travelling from Bangkok, what is the best way to get to Khao Sok?
The easiest and most convenient way from Bangkok to Khao Sok is either fly to Surat Thani Airport or take the train to Phunpin Station (Surat Thani Train Station). There are also night buses direct to Khao Sok. You can find detailed instructions here .
